headline: Government to Mandate Semiconductor Plants Include Dedicated Stalls for Making Jalebis to Boost Local Productivity
body:
The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology has announced that the 5-8 upcoming semiconductor plants, slated for construction over the next seven years, will be legally required to feature integrated 'Jalebi Zones' to ensure optimal engineer morale. According to a senior policy advisor, the synergy between micro-circuitry and the art of deep-frying sugar-soaked batter is essential for national technological self-reliance.

'We realized that waiting for a transistor to cool down is the perfect window to prepare a batch of crispy, syrup-laden jalebis,' explained the ministry’s newly appointed Director of Snack-Integrated Manufacturing, Ramesh Varma. 'Our research indicates that the steam from the frying pan actually acts as a natural flux that stabilizes high-frequency wafer yields, provided the batter is whisked by someone with a minimum of ten years of experience in regional halwai techniques.'

The initiative, internally dubbed 'Chip-n-Chai 2.0,' will require every clean-room facility to dedicate at least 40% of its floor space to traditional cookware. Foreign chip manufacturers looking to partner with local firms have reportedly been sent a mandatory checklist that includes procurement of high-quality ghee and the recruitment of at least three master chefs per shift. 

Industry experts have welcomed the move, noting that while the global chip shortage remains a complex challenge, the addition of fresh snacks will likely ensure that engineers remain at their workstations for at least 18 hours a day. The government expects this localized approach to yield not only high-performance processors but also the world's most sugar-dusted silicon wafers.
caption: The future of Indian tech is looking sweet. New chip plants to feature mandatory Jalebi zones for peak efficiency. #TechNews #MakeInIndia #Semiconductors #Innovation (satire)

Its invented details—like the 'Director of Snack-Integrated Manufacturing' and the specific use of steam as a natural flux—provide the perfect level of deadpan commitment to the bit.
